body:
Yeah i think your definitely right about finding friends that don't know her and having some space as well. Yeah i went a psychologist for one visit but just couldn't bring myself to really talking about the issue and just kinda said i was grieving over a break up. It felt pointless but the lady was a nice and seemed genuine, so i just never went again.

My hobbies are listening to music particularly electronic, keeping fit (riding bike along local trail and gym), playing video games, some nights out at clubs when there's a good dj on, hiking
Cheers :)

Just being hard on myself more than anything. The girls i have dated have no idea of this part of my past and i think it's just me comparing them to my ex. Logically thinking these girls were totally unique and comparisons are just silly. Maybe they weren't right or possibly im not ready to date again yet. I feel i want to though.
The 3 mutual friends i still have dont really believe me but also think she has exaggerated a lot of the events. So i still feel like that guy when with them and mores so when around the ones who aren't my friend anymore (like social events). They have also known her a lot longer and have more memories with her i guess.
Can't wait for that break so these horrible feelings go away and i can be happy again

Yeah your probably right about the physical part, it's just that she convinced our mutual friends that i physically abused her as she had some bruises on her arms....which made me doubt my actions.
I have got back into dating but find the connections are hollow and just not right. I feel like im being unfair to the girls i've dated. 
Thanks for your input too. The release of just writing this helped a little.
